newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit in range trade, focus on Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit in range trade, focus on Greenspan.

text.p: The ringgit was trapped in a boxed-range against the dollar thoughout Wednesday's session as most traders were sidelined ahead of U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins congressional testimony starting at 1500 GMT, dealers said.
"Nobody wants to do anything while waiting for the outcome of Greenspan's speech today," said one Malaysian bank dealer. "Greenspan could shed some light on the direction of the market."
Dealers said muted dollar/majors movements also limited activity in dollar/ringgit.
Some American banks were buying dollar/ringgit in the morning, pressuring the local unit slightly lower from overnight level, dealers said.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4811/16 a dollar against 2.4795/05 at the close of Kuala Lumpur on Tuesday.
Dealers said they expected dollar/ringgit to trade between 2.4750 and 2.4900 in the near-term.
Japanese companies' repatriation of profits out of Malaysia ahead of their financial year-end book closing at end-March could provide support for dollar/ringgit, they said.
